summary: Play educational games for kids. Learn logic & scratch jr coding
description:
Code Land is an educational app that uses fun, accessible games to teach coding, problem solving and critical thinking skills to children aged 4-10. Inspired by beginner coding tools like scratch jr, Code Land helps kids take their first steps into programming in a playful and intuitive way.

By playing games, children can learn basic skills for the 21st century, such as computer science, programming, logic, and more. If your child enjoys apps like scratch jr, they will feel right at home exploring Code Land’s learning games.

The games and activities are specially designed to be accessible to all, so that no child is excluded. From visual games where you don't even need to know how to read, to advanced coding multiplayer games, there’s something in Code Land’s library of games for everyone.

All games are designed to be fun and educational. They are set in a variety of situations, such as setting up a factory or getting out of a maze, emphasizing problem solving and logic building skills, while going beyond what apps like scratch jr offer.

Play and learn coding freely without pressure or stress. Kids can think, act, observe, ask questions and find the answers with Code Land and the Learny Land suite of games.

FEATURES:

• Educational games teach key coding concepts
• Logical thinking and problem solving skills are a core feature
• Hundreds of challenges spread across various worlds and games
• Programming and coding concepts for kids such as loops, sequences, actions, conditions, and events
• No downloadable content makes it easy to play offline
• Child-friendly interfaces and easy and intuitive scenarios
• Games and content for everyone with no limiting stereotypes. Anyone can learn programming & start coding!
• Content for children 4 years old and up
• Supports multiple users
• No ads, no data collection
• No written communication between players or with other people
• No commitments or inconveniences; cancel at any time
• New games and content are added regularly
• Create your own games
• Learn coding from scratch

Code Land - Coding for Kids SUBSCRIPTION:

• Download and try all the games for free, without any commitment
• The full, unlimited version works through an annual or monthly subscription
• Payment will be charged to your Play Store account
• The subscription is automatically renewed unless renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to the user's account settings after purchase

Privacy Policy

We take Privacy very seriously. Code Land - Coding for Kids does not collect or share personal information about your children or allow any type of third party ads. To learn more, please read our privacy policy at [www.learnyland.com](http://www.learnyland.com).
